results.content:
## What Is Missed Call Text-Back?

Missed call text-back is an automated SMS system that sends a text message to a caller the moment their call goes unanswered. When someone calls your business and you don't pick up. whether you're on another call, with a customer, or closed for the day. the system fires an instant text to their number. The caller gets an acknowledgment within seconds rather than reaching dead voicemail, and you stay in contact with a lead who would otherwise be lost. [...] ## How AIRA Solves Missed Calls Before They Happen

Rather than reacting to missed calls with a text, AIRA prevents them. AIRA is an AI receptionist that answers every inbound call to your business. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. with no hold time and no voicemail. Callers get their questions answered, their appointments booked, their emergencies routed, and their information collected in real time. [...] Missed call text-back is a reactive system. It waits for a call to go unanswered, then sends a text. By the time the text arrives, the caller has already experienced the friction of not being helped. Research shows that text-back messages receive response rates of 15-25%. meaning 75-85% of callers who receive an automated text don't engage, and many have already called a competitor.

AI call answering is proactive. It answers every call before it becomes a missed call. A caller who reaches an AI receptionist immediately gets greeted by name, has their question answered, their appointment booked, or their emergency routed. all in real time. The call never goes unanswered. The text-back problem doesn't exist because there are no missed calls to follow up on.

Keep text-back and layer it. AI phone answering picks up every call in real time, handles the conversation, captures caller info, and routes emergencies -- then sends a follow-up text after the call as reinforcement. This is the AI virtual receptionist approach: handle the conversation first, reinforce with text. The text becomes a value-add instead of a last resort. You can set up an AI answering service in 5 minutes alongside your existing text-back, or explore how an AI receptionist handles missed calls as a complement. [...] ## What Is Missed Call Text Back?

Missed call text back automatically sends an SMS to anyone who calls your business and doesn't get an answer. Instead of the caller hitting voicemail (which almost nobody checks), they get a text in their pocket within 30-60 seconds.

Here's the basic flow:

 A customer calls your business number
 The call goes unanswered (you're on a job, in a meeting, after hours)
 The system detects the missed call within seconds
 An automated SMS sends to the caller's phone
 The caller receives a personalized message acknowledging their call
 They can text back, starting a two-way conversation [...] ## When Text-Back Isn't Enough (and What to Add)

Missed call text back handles acknowledgment well, but there are scenarios where texting alone leaves gaps.

In our corpus of 1,446,980 real inbound calls, urgency language like "emergency," "urgent," or "ASAP" shows up in a meaningful share of home services calls. A text promising a callback in 30 minutes doesn't solve a burst pipe flooding someone's basement. And even with a 45% SMS response rate, that means 55% of missed callers who receive your text still don't engage -- they saw it, read it, and called someone else.

These callers want a conversation, not a text thread.
